text: Machine learning is a type of artificial intelligence that allows computers to learn from data without being explicitly programmed. One common approach is supervised learning, where a model is trained using labelled training data. During this process, the model looks at many examples and learns the relationship between the input and the correct output. Once training is complete, the model can make predictions about new, unseen data. The quality of these predictions is measured by accuracy, which shows how often the model is correct. Good training data is essential, because the more reliable the data, the better the model performs.
